title: observability: add token-level KV cache and tracing metrics, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Aisha Raman
description:
Motivation: we need better visibility into token-level cost and latency for KV-cache-backed generation flows. Recent incidents showed elevated tail latencies when KV cache population rate spiked; existing metrics are high-level and do not separate KV lookup cost from decode costs. This PR introduces token-level KV cache metrics, tracing spans for KV lookup/populate, Grafana dashboards for cost/latency breakdown, and tuned alert rules to reduce noise while catching regressions.

What this PR does: - Adds Prometheus metrics: redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_kv_cache_populates_total, redwood_kv_kv_lookup_duration_seconds (histogram), redwood_token_latency_seconds (labelled by component: decode|kv_lookup|kv_populate), redwood_token_cost_units_total (counter) - Adds OpenTelemetry tracing spans around KV lookup and KV populate paths with attributes: model_name, deployment, request_id, kv_key_count, cache_hit - Adds a new Grafana dashboard (token-level cost/latency + KV cache heatmap) and a companion dashboard for per-route and per-model cost breakdown - Adds alert tuning: separate alerts for kv_cache_miss_rate (P90>5% for 10m), token_latency_p95_by_component (trigger only if p95>service-target and error-rate stable), and budget-exhaustion early warning using token_cost_rate - Updates docs with migration notes and how to interpret the new dashboards - Adds integration tests simulating high KV populate rates to verify metrics emitted and alerts firing in local devstack

Checklist: - [x] Add metrics and histograms - [x] Add tracing spans and attributes - [x] Add Grafana dashboards JSON - [x] Add Prometheus alert rules and tuned thresholds - [x] Update docs - [x] Add integration test harness - [x] Run CI and address failures

Notes: thresholds were chosen after running the benchmark-lab workload with sampled production traces. The alert tuning aims to reduce pager noise by correlating latency regressions with error-rate and cache miss spikes. Related: ENG-2412 (observability token-level cost), ENG-2480 (kv-cache perf investigation).

release_notes:
- Added token-level KV cache metrics and tracing spans
- New Grafana dashboards for token-level cost and latency breakdowns
- Tuned Prometheus alerts for KV miss rate and token latency to reduce noise
- Docs and integration tests for token-level observability
notes: This change is backward compatible for metrics consumers; new metric names are additive. Dashboard JSON includes templating variables for cluster and model. Ops should roll out Prometheus rule updates during a quiet window to validate alert thresholds in staging before production rollout.
